events.description: Called with the sort a press on a sortable header asks for; the app fetches the rows in that order.
events.name: onSortChange

events.description: Called when the end of the rows is reached while `hasMore` is true and nothing is loading.
events.name: onLoadMore

events.description: Web: called with a column's new width, in CSS pixels, when a resize ends.
events.name: onColumnResize

events.description: Web: given, headers can be dragged to reorder the columns; called with the column and its new index.
events.name: onColumnMove

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

props.description: The spoken name of the table, for example "Orders"; a table without one is anonymous to assistive technology.
props.name: label

props.description: The columns, in reading order.
props.name: columns

props.description:
The content of one cell. Left out, a cell shows the text of the row's property named by the column's `id`; give it
to draw a badge, a date or a link, and give the app's own text for each value, as the table adds none.
props.name: renderCell

props.description: The look of the table. Defaults to `primary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: True while a cursor page after the last row exists; with `onLoadMore` it loads it when the end comes into view.
props.name: hasMore

props.description: True to keep the header in view while the rows scroll; the table then scrolls inside `maxHeight`.
props.name: isStickyHeader

props.description: The height the rows scroll inside when the header is sticky, as a CSS length. Defaults to `24rem`.
props.name: maxHeight

props.description:
The sort in force, every key most significant first, for a controlled table: the rows arrive sorted, and this only
marks the headers (the first by its direction, the others by their rank too).
props.name: sort

props.description: How tightly the rows are drawn: `compact`, `normal` (the default) or `roomy`. Native reads it as nothing.
props.name: density

props.description:
Web: true to give each header a resize handle (pointer, and the keyboard through the column menu's "Resize"); the
columns then take their `width`, `minWidth` and `maxWidth`, and the table scrolls sideways past its width.
props.name: isColumnResizable

props.description:
Web: what sits at the end of a header, usually the column's menu. `startResize` starts a keyboard resize of the
column (arrows, then Enter or Escape) when the table is resizable.
props.name: renderColumnMenu
props.type: (column: TableColumn, tools: { readonly startResize: () => void; }) => ReactNode

props.description: The items, in order. The collection never sorts or filters them: the query that fetched them did.
props.name: items

props.description: What the collection shows when `items` is empty and nothing is loading, usually an `EmptyState`.
props.name: emptyState

props.description: True while items load: the collection is busy, and shows its loading state in place of the empty one.
props.name: isLoading

props.description: The spoken name of what loads, for example "Loading orders"; it is read only while `isLoading` is true.
props.name: loadingLabel

props.description: What a press or Space does: nothing, select one item, or toggle several. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description: Style
props.name: style

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID
